reason: The gap identified involves understanding how pregnancy weight gain is measured differently between two distinct datasets, NCFRP_v51 (case series) and PRAMS_P8_ARF (population reference). This difference in measurement could introduce significant biases when comparing the data from these sources, affecting the validity of any conclusions drawn about pregnancy weight gain patterns among SUID cases versus live births. Addressing this gap would help refine our understanding of how such discrepancies impact case-population comparisons and potentially influence public health recommendations.
